scope: Observed machine results and researcher thematic title/abstract assessment of nine records: seven definitive labels and two unresolved cases. Human citation/extraction correctness and controlled time savings have not been established. The search is bounded.

metric_notes.agreement: Two prompt roles using the same model. Includes include, exclude and uncertain labels. Not independent human agreement.
metric_notes.full_text_decision_coverage: Definite include or exclude recommendations divided by assessed full texts; not accuracy.
metric_notes.full_text_access_rate: PDF availability among the retrieved unique records; not search recall.
metric_notes.human_metrics: Nine researcher title/abstract relevance assessments: seven definite labels used for binary scores and two explicit uncertainties excluded from binary scoring. Four machine uncertainties within the scored subset count as incorrect for strict accuracy. Citation/extraction/completeness ratings remain unassessed. Timings are incomplete estimates.
metric_notes.index_count: The completed run log recorded 1959 indexed passages. This is not a count of verified scientific claims.
